history.name: The authoring rules, on demand
history.description: `ledger rules` prints the full house rules for writing the record — what each field means, how to size an entry, where the line between the client's and the team's readership sits, when a sub-section is warranted, and what isn't worth an entry at all. A project that keeps its own copy gets that one instead, so a team can add its own conventions without losing the rest.
history.dev_notes: cmdRules prints .ledger/RULES.md when present, else the packaged assets/RULES.md; works even outside a project.
